title: Validating Concurrent Correctness Witnesses with Ghosts by Thread-Modular Abstract Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23792v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Concurrent programs are notoriously difficult to write and to reason about, and even tools based on sound theoretical foundations can produce incorrect results due to implementation bugs. Correctness witnesses have been proposed as a way to increase the confidence in the verdicts of software verifiers by enabling independent validation. Recently, correctness witnesses have been extended to the concurrent setting, by introducing ghost variables to allow encoding more expressive invariants. While different approaches to producing witnesses with ghosts exist, validation techniques are still lacking; instead of leveraging the information encoded in the ghosts to guide the validation process, validators merely treat ghost instrumentation and invariants over ghost variables as additional proof obligations. We propose a novel framework for the validation of concurrent correctness witnesses that exploits the semantic information encoded in gho

translated_title: 通过线程模块化抽象解释验证带幽灵变量的并发正确性见证
translated_abstract: 并发程序的编写和推理是出了名的困难，即使是基于健全理论基础的工具，也可能由于实现缺陷而产生错误的结果。正确性见证被提出作为一种通过支持独立验证来提高软件验证器判定结果可信度的方法。最近，通过引入幽灵变量以允许编码更具表达力的不变式，正确性见证已被扩展到并发场景。尽管存在多种生成带幽灵变量见证的方法，但相应的验证技术仍然缺乏；验证器并没有利用幽灵变量中编码的信息来指导验证过程，而只是将幽灵插桩和关于幽灵变量的不变式视为额外的证明义务。我们提出了一种新颖的并发正确性见证验证框架，该框架利用幽灵变量中编码的语义信息……
tldr: 提出了一种新颖的并发正确性见证验证框架，利用幽灵变量中编码的语义信息，通过线程模块化抽象解释来验证带幽灵变量的并发正确性见证，而非将其简单视为额外的证明义务。
en_tdlr: A novel framework is proposed to validate concurrent correctness witnesses with ghosts by exploiting the semantic information encoded in ghost variables through thread-modular abstract interpretation, rather than treating ghost instrumentation and invariants as mere additional proof obligations.
